messageBody:
## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CMEs (Psyche, Solar Orbiter)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-06-17T20:46:33Z
## Message ID: 20240617-AL-002
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Multiple CMEs have been detected as follows:
1: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-17T08:24Z.

Estimated speed: ~902 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 39 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): -151/-34 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-17T08:24:00-CME-001

2: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-17T08:48Z.

Estimated speed: ~557 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 26 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 170/-43 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-17T08:48:00-CME-001

3: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-17T11:00Z.

Estimated speed: ~755 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 45 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): -176/29 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-17T11:00:00-CME-001

4: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-17T11:12Z.

Estimated speed: ~655 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 25 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 174/-37 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-17T11:12:00-CME-001

Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CMEs may impact Psyche (glancing blow) and Solar Orbiter (glancing blow).  The combined flank of the CMEs will reach Psyche at 2024-06-24T12:00Z and Solar Orbiter at 2024-06-20T18:00Z (plus minus 7 hours).

## Notes: 
CME with ID 2024-06-17T08:24:00-CME-001 was previously simulated to give a glancing blow to Psyche at 2024-06-24T08:00Z and Solar Orbiter at 2024-06-21T02:00Z (plus minus 7 hours) (see notification 20240617-AL-001).


SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
